entries.text: TPC-DS OBT (tpcds_obt) now accepts the same scale factors as TPC-DS from the CLI and the Python API: any value from 0.001 to 100000, with values of 1 or more given as whole numbers. The CLI previously accepted only scale factor 1, and the Python API rejected every scale below 1.
The benchmark listing and MCP benchmark discovery now report 90 queries for TPC-DS OBT, its SQL query count, instead of 17, its DataFrame query count.
